Job Posting: 178936 - Position: S26 Project Manager 178936 Co-op Work Term Posted: 2026 - Summer App Deadline Application Method: Posting Goes Live: Job Posting Status: 03/16/2026 09:00 AM Through Employer Website 03/09/2026 01:49 PM Approved ORGANIZATION INFORMATION Organization Address Line 1 City Province / State Country Brixton Metals 409 Granville St., Suite 551 Vancouver BC Canada JOB POSTING INFORMATION Placement Term <b> Job Title <b> Position Type Job Location Country Duration Salary Currency Salary Salary Range $ Job Description 2026 - Summer S26 Project Manager 178936 Co-op Position Whitehorse, YT Canada 4 months CAD Salary Not Available, 0 Major List $40.00-$45.00/hour Brixton Metals Corporation is a publicly traded (TSXV: BBB) (OCTQB: BBBXF), Canadian mineral exploration company focused on the advancement of its copper-gold-silver exploration projects. Brixton wholly owns four exploration projects in BC, Ontario and Montana. The position of Project Manager (seasonal, cross-shift) is located at Brixton Metal's Thorn Project in Northwest British Columbia (near Whitehorse, YT) for May - August 2026 (anticipated) with the possibility of extension. RESPONSIBILITIES The main responsibilities include, but are not limited to: • Budget management and reporting; • Providing project updates to management on a consistent basis; • Logistics planning including management of fuel and supplies transported via airplane and helicopter; • Staff scheduling and payroll reporting; • Managing contracts with vendors and suppliers; • Overseeing the camp catering, maintenance, contractors, and safety & environmental matters; • Maintenance and troubleshooting of equipment and remote camp infrastructure; • Leading regular safety meetings and upholding safety standards; • Completion of Mine Hazard and Accident Reports and timely filing of WorkSafe BC reports as required; • Directing fire response teams and environmental impact mitigation; • Additional work in and around the work site as required; and • Demonstrate awareness and commitment to health, safety, community and environmental protection in keeping with Brixton Metals goals and objectives. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION • This position is a cross-shift with training provided. • Work location is a remote, live-in camp, which is only accessible by air and is located in Northwest British Columbia (near Whitehorse, YT). • Ability to work in areas of extreme and difficult weather conditions. • Rotational schedule is required (long work rotations). • Must be able to lift/move up to 50lbs throughout a work shift. • Pay rate: $40.00-$45.00/hour, commensurate with experience. Learn more about Careers at Brixton Metals: https://brixtonmetals.com/careers/ Job Requirements QUALIFICATIONS • A Business Diploma or at least 2 years project management experience plus past mineral exploration and/or mining experience is preferred. • Knowledge in the workings of diamond drills considered an asset • Eligible to work in Canada at time of application. • Valid driver's license. • Reliable with a strong work ethic. • Cooperative team player. • This position may be well suited to individuals with strong project management abilities along with skills in trades (electrical, construction, plumbing, equipment repairs).
